name: FFS_INVENTORY
description: Used to store all inventory items.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Inventory, automatically populated by the system.

columns.name: POOL
columns.description: Pool that inventory relaets to. Possible values: 'customer', 'install', 'deinstall', 'provider'. Default value: 'customer'.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_RESOURCE.RESOURCE_ID value. Resource which the inventory belongs to.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_ACTIVITY.ACTIVITY_ID value. Activity which the inventory belongs to.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Serial number in case of Serialized Inventory.

columns.name: EXCHANGED_INVENTORY_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_INVENTORY.INVENTORY_ID value. The ID of inventory which was changed by the current inventory.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity in case of Non-Serialized Inventory.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
